_note: S2 e002 = e001 + ONE change: random temporal crop of the training feature sequence (train_crop_frames=512). Decision 823680cb accepted this to remove the absolute collision/entry position shortcut (e001 val time_mae_s 7.404 was ~11x worse than the constant-position baseline). Eval always uses the FULL sequence, so the val metric stays comparable to e001 on release s2-labels-v6. Sequences are 540-1286 frames @ ~30fps; collision positions span 245-1093, so a 512-frame window fully randomizes the within-window target index. const_baseline (train-median position) is reported in metrics.json as the score to beat. Labels are agent_labels_v6 proxy (NOT official GT). Falsification: if crop MAE does not beat the constant-prediction MAE on the same val, hold S2 retraining until the nexar_event expansion lands.
